svg.title: Ila holds apart conflicting ward maps while Riju stops his pencil.
svg.desc: Household cards remain inside a boundary on an older electoral sheet although a later map abolishes the ward. Ila explains that maps embody different political questions, and Riju refrains from altering either source.
svg.text: Page 19, panel 4 · Eye-level two-shot across an electoral sheet and a stack of household cards

text.tspan: An electoral map still places families inside a ward
abolished years ago, exposing the politics behind
